dogecoin.text: Here's just one reason why #Dogecoin is super HIGH RISK.....  If Elon Musk says he decided to sell his Dogecoin, it would crash to 0.05 in a heartbeat.

@MarketWatch A CEO of a mega-cap publicly traded company should NOT be pumping fragile and highly risky crypto on Twitter or ANYWHERE.  If he mentions Dogecoin on SNL in any respect whatsoever, the SEC should intervene.

#Dogecoin fans:  Accepting Doge as payment to send a satellite into orbit means NOTHING. Why?  Customer buys Dogecoin to pay SpaceX. SpaceX then accepts Doge as payment and immediately dumps it for cash. Sounds like more of a pump and dump than a positive event.

#Bitcoin #HODL #Dogecoin When people can't log into their accounts to buy or sell at the most vital times, this should indicate even to the most "astute" Diamond Hands HODL-er that crypto is in the hands of criminal enterprise.
